notes: Where the explicit pronoun הֵמָּה is written, it takes the English subject pronoun and the verb keeps only auxiliary and lexeme; where no pronoun is written the verb takes the pronoun itself (rules 17, 20).
The second coordinated verb נָתְנוּ takes only make: the ASV does not rewrite the subject or auxiliary (rule 22).
לָכֵן is one word MACULA splits into R and D and the ASV renders by the single therefore, so the two morphemes share a unit headed on כֵן (rule 30).
